title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Repaint and Grille Replacement
summary: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE received a repainted hood and new front grille at Carcis Autobody Repair in Vancouver, WA.
story: This 2017 Toyota Camry XSE came to the shop for front-end service. The job required repainting the hood and replacing the front grille assembly.

Before painting a hood, the panel surface is thoroughly cleaned, sanded, and prepared. Proper preparation ensures durable adhesion for the primer, base coat, and clear coat layers. Matching the factory black paint tone maintains a uniform finish across adjacent panels.

The front grille replacement was installed to complete the front assembly. After applying the final clear coat and allowing it to cure, the surface was inspected under light to confirm proper coverage.
